title: Protein stabilization in spray drying and solid-state storage by using a ‘molecular lock’ – exploiting bacterial adaptations for industrial applications
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,263-272
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00202D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wiktoria Brytan, Tewfik Soulimane, Luis Padrela
The presence of a C-terminal extension in a thermophilic aldehyde dehydrogenase protein is found to act like a ‘molecular lock’ to the oligomeric state of the tetramer upon spray drying, increasing activity retention without the use of excipients.
